data.name: Toxic
data.description: %1 times per day (a number equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day)), a vishkanya can envenom a weapon that he wields with his toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires the vishkanya to be injured when he uses this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action.|max(CON,1)
